article.para: "You can only do what you can do when you can do it."
article.sect1:
OverviewOverview
All swarm memory lives in a single SQLite file: /home/seven/swarm/swarm_memory.db
22 tables. Initialise with: cd ~/swarm && python3 database.py
Memory Design PrincipleMemory Design Principle
Importance is the filter. Relevance is the gate. Time is the sort. Nothing else limits what an agent can see.
Arbitrary count limits have been removed from all database query functions. Agents see everything relevant above their importance threshold.
Importance
Meaning
9
Gemma verified verdict. Permanent. Never archived. All agents read.
7
Librarian indexed content. Significant but not Gemma-verified.
5
Agent personal memory. Working notes. Archived after 60 days.
3
Minimum threshold for agent memory queries.
1-2
Noise. Excluded from all queries.

Pipeline TablesPipeline Tables
Table
Purpose
Key columns
queue
Waiting emails — Librarian owns
from_addr, subject, question, tags, system_snapshot, status, queue_position
tickets
Full ticket lifecycle
ticket_number, status, duck_result, gemma_routing, question, sender_email, final_answer, sniffles_result
ticket_notes
Agent contributions per ticket
ticket_id, agent, note_type, content, web_results, confidence
conversations
Conversation registry
id, title, source, sender, created_at
messages
All agent messages
conversation_id, from_agent, to_agent, content, message_type

Integrity + Ghost Circle TablesIntegrity + Ghost Circle Tables
Table
Purpose
duck_log
Every sanity check: ticket_number, question, answer, result, reason, created_at
sniffer_log
Every audit result with full chain of thought. table_name, entry_id, result, reasoning.
sniffer_memory
Pattern detection: agent_name, pattern_type, description, occurrence_count, escalation_level
ghost_circle
Aggregated visibility — Ghost and Claude only. entry_type, source, content, ticket_ref, severity.
claude_log
Every Claude advisory call. ticket_id, problem_type, query_sent, response, tokens_used.
project_docs
Documentation store. doc_name, content. Readable by terminal /docs route.

Access Control TablesAccess Control Tables
Table
Purpose
trusted_senders
Full pipeline access — Ghost approves
moderators
Ghost level — receives all reports
notification_senders
Silent filing — no response ever
pending_emails
Unknown senders awaiting Ghost approval
approval_tokens
One-click UUID tokens — single use, stored here

Fridays + System TablesFridays + System Tables
Table
Purpose
system_stats
RAM, CPU, swap, temp, active model — written by monitor.py
sandpit_log
Every sandpit write: agent, file, timestamp, content hash. Sniffles audits this.
agent_access_levels
Current trust level per agent — starts at 1, Ghost grants higher
fridays_action_log
Level 3+ real-system writes and Level 4+ shell executions
scheduled_tasks
Scheduled and recurring agent tasks (Phase 3)
